description: Fetch a URL server-side and extract its title, meta description, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, canonical URL and favicon — the data agents need to preview or classify a link. SSRF-guarded: private networks are blocked, 10s timeout, 1MB cap. Use this when an agent needs to title, description, OG image and favicon of any page. x402 price $0.003/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: live_url_metadata
title: URL Metadata (Live)
